Our Story

The Classic Baking Tradition

Tehzeeb is a culture, tradition, lifestyle and class of Pakistan, with a legacy of more than 114 years. The bakery is exceedingly popular among society — including presidents, prime ministers, diplomats and the royalty visiting Pakistan from all across the world.

We believe in making this world a better place by sharing love, empathy and happiness — one baked box at a time.
